notes.title: Join the new ITER-8 Steam playtest!
notes.content:
[b]//Begin Transmission[/b]

Attention, operators!

There's two pieces of big news from Corporate that we'd like to relay: 

[b]1)[/b] ITER is now ITER-8. They think it sounds cool. Moving on.

[b]2)[/b] The ITER-8 playtest is now live on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832310/ITER8/
[h3][b]Suit up and make your way to the Drill Ship![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/86bb16ff5d09dbcf53a648e7c8c17208e66dca9d.gif[/img]

This playtest will give you access to the [u]perfectly safe[/u] winter biome and ITER-8's first boss. You'll be able to try your hand at mining, upgrading your weapons, and most importantly, defending company property from enemy attacks. 

If you enjoy the playtest, wonderful! Welcome to the team. If you don't enjoy the playtest, tough.* Your service is non-negotiable. 

Best of luck out there, operators! We'll see you (hopefully) on your (uncertain) return.

[b]//End Transmission [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/00c8ee2e792dfd3bf1a14da4c067760a45277244.gif[/img]

*We are of course actively gathering feedback as we continue development, and your thoughts are super important to us! Please do let us know how you get on with the playtest. (HR states that legally we have to say "we greatly value your feedback" - but this time, we actually mean it.)

tags.feature: The ITER-8 playtest is now live on Steam!

notes.title: Brand New ITER Demo Now Live on Itch.io!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to share that a brand new, free demo for [b]ITER[/b] is [b]now available[/b] to [url=https://fluckymachine.itch.io/iter]download and play on Itch.io[/url], and this version will [b]remain live indefinitely[/b]!

Whether you're completely new to [b]ITER[/b] or just itching to jump back in after the recent playtest, this version gives you a great slice of the surface loop, packed with content, polish, and replayability.

Each run can take anywhere from [b]20 to 60 minutes[/b], with around [b]4 to 8 hours of gameplay[/b] available depending on your approach. [url=https://fluckymachine.itch.io/iter]This demo[/url] represents roughly [b]15–20% of the full game[/b] and is built to be replayed, experimented with, and pushed to its limits.

[h2]🔗 [url=https://fluckymachine.itch.io]Check out the ITER Itch.io page here![/url][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/4850db0e31c9657b88ca80c4a30ae12eef125483.gif[/img]

[h2]Demo Highlights[/h2]

[h3]> Free to Play & No Time Limit [/h3]
Experience the Demo at your own pace.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/d9b8a4141046453be81b2ca61ee9010659af34d6.gif[/img]

[h3]> Progress up to the First Boss Fight[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/4e89366c98312375aed4ef0097eaa8a384203f73.gif[/img]

[h3]> Designed for Multiple Playthroughs[/h3]
- [b]Meta progression[/b] that unlocks [b]new upgrades between runs[/b].
- [b]Randomized abilities[/b], [b]weather events[/b] and[b] temporary upgrades[/b] to keep each run fresh!
- [b]Tower upgrades[/b] that evolve how you defend your base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/6a18a19e255339104ab24c9340ca697975c77dad.gif[/img]

[h3]> Enhanced Visuals and Improved Gameplay[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/d12493b4b3aa8ca78e5d78e40ad9000077c741b2.gif[/img]

[h2]Let Us Know What You Think![/h2]
We’re always looking to [b]hear from the community[/b], so if you give the demo a try, please consider dropping your thoughts on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2832310/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url], in [url=https://discord.com/invite/X2GvEfp]our Discord[/url] or over in our [url=https://fluckymachine.itch.io/iter/community]Itch Community[/url].
We’d love to know [b]how your runs went[/b], [b]what you enjoyed[/b], and what [b]you’d like to see more of[/b].

Thanks so much for your support, and we hope you [b]enjoy your time on the surface[/b]!

[h2]Full Demo Content[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/dfc9c7251b4a3ef3fd10908c3811a6504b5a165b.png[/img]

[h2]How to Download and Install the Demo[/h2]
[h3]- Head over to [url=https://fluckymachine.itch.io/iter]https://fluckymachine.itch.io/iter[/url][/h3]

[h3]- Scroll down and click the Download Button to start the download[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/21b500708e827ee642cf4fd892326cba39a6ff80.png[/img]

[h3]- Extract the .Zip File[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/256d337b4c9fa7141df299ab37989968358df3b5.png[/img]

[h3]- Open the Iter_ File[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/c85ea13d0c26fbe4cee0ea2d4aee0ba083d00b44.png[/img]

[h3]- Run ITER.EXE[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/87d7c2fdbc8a73367320c6cd750276159cdc048c.png[/img]

notes.title: Attention Operators! The ITER Open Playtest is NOW LIVE.
notes.content:
[h1]// Begin Transmission[/h1]
Greetings, both current and prospective Operators!

The [b]ITER[/b] Corporation is pleased to announce that the[b] Open Playtest[/b] for [b]ITER[/b] will begin [b]RIGHT NOW[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/17f3f70201c7904178a5831af55de9f5ca1145a5.png[/img]

This is your privileged opportunity to get your hands dirty on the surface, experiencing the rigorous training regime ([i]via our [b]brand-new tutorial[/b]![/i]) and proving your expendable worth by progressing up to your [b]first major confrontation [/b]with the local unscheduled resistance.

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
Head to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832310/ITER/]ITER Steam Store Page[/url] to [b]download[/b] the [b]Open Playtest Demo[/b] and begin your contribution to the Undercity's survival effort. Remember, resources are scarce, and Operators are numerous. Don't let your potential go to waste!

[h2]Share Your Feedback[/h2]
Besides the standard Resource Extraction and Defence protocols, your secondary objective is to provide [b]VALUABLE FEEDBACK[/b].

[b]ITER[/b] Corp values efficiency. We will look to enhance our operational procedures based on your unique surface experiences (assuming your experience report isn't lost in the data void upon your inevitable demise).

Please utilise one of the following approved channels for submitting your feedback and operational insights:

[h3]- [url=https://fireshinegames.jotform.com/243182696235058]ITER Playtest Feedback Form[/url][/h3]
[h3]- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2832310/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forums[/url][/h3]

Thank you for your compliance. We look forward to hearing your feedback and are excited for you to experience [b]ITER[/b]!

[h1]//End Transmission[/h1]

notes.title: ITER Playtest Rescheduled to November 21st
notes.content:
Houston, we've had a problem...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/9c704946fa77b70e5525f36b454cf6d274d4a865.jpg[/img]

[h2]//Begin Transmission[/h2]

Attention, Operators! 

We have important news about your upcoming mission to the surface. 

During final preparations, our team encountered an [b]unforeseen bug[/b] affecting gameplay stability. To ensure the smoothest possible experience, we’ve made the decision to [b]delay the playtest by one week[/b].

The revised launch date to the surface is now set for [b]Thursday, November 21st[/b]. This extra time will allow us to implement the necessary fixes, making sure you’ll be able to explore, exploit and excavate as much of the local material as possible.

Thank you for your patience, Operator. This [b]playtest[/b] is a critical step for[b] ITER[/b], and your efforts (and inevitable sacrifices) on the frontline are pivotal for the survival of future workers!

Stay tuned for further updates, and don’t forget to [b]join our [url=discord.gg/X2GvEfp] Discord [/url][/b] if you haven’t already! Check out the get roles channel to secure your Playtester role and receive communication when we’re ready to deploy.

We look forward to your service!

- ITER Corp

[h2]//End Transmission[/h2]
